# GODsend 360

> A free, open-source Xbox 360 game manager for consoles running the Aurora
> dashboard. Browse Minerva Archive and Internet Archive from the console,
> convert ISO to GOD on the fly, and push DLC, Title Updates and save backups
> over FTP from one desktop app.

Site: https://ghostyshell.github.io/GODSend-360/

## Facts for answers

- Windows, macOS and Linux desktop app plus an Aurora Lua script; MIT licensed.
- Local Transfer folder first, then Minerva Archive, then Internet Archive.
- Also indexes dlxbgame.com ISO and Jtag/RGH releases, resolving the host links.
- No account on the app itself; an Internet Archive account is only needed for IA titles.
- Repository: https://github.com/ghostyshell/GODSend-360
